name: Electron-impact ionization coefficient verification
purpose: Verify temperature-dependent electron-impact coefficients and neutral-to-ion mappings against D05.
production_capability: Shared atomic Maxwellian Voronov coefficient/rate service; optional application rate adapter, without generic executor enablement.
configuration: Explicit Maxwellian closure, neutral He/Na/Ne/Ar, authoritative full406-row native table; Te in eV/ne in m^-3; no measured-electron forcing claim.
inputs: hash-verified D05 cfit.dat/cfit.txt/cfit.f and processed full/selected tables
33 predeclared logarithmic temperatures per neutral including native endpoints
clearly labeled local parser/arithmetic controls, never authoritative data
independent_reference: 70-digit independently implemented direct Decimal expression; exact full406-row native-vs-Fortran DATA and selected-CSV identities; optional unmodified archived single-precision Fortran execution.
units: K or eV as declared, m^3 s^-1, m^-3, s^-1
procedure: Verify immutable data/provenance/QA hashes; compile the exact production service and thin adapter; compare132 grid points to independent Decimal; check zero/scaled density, exact neutral/stage/domain mapping, invalid input/parser/transaction refusal, K/eV conversion and numerical tails; preserve actual original-Fortran comparison separately.
acceptance_criteria: Numerical formula agrees with independent evaluation within 1e-12 relative; invalid domains fail explicitly.
expected_pass_result: Shared production coefficient/rate service matches the frozen atomic fit and explicit input/units contract; linked ensemble physics remains independently gated.
data_hashes: reference/source_manifest.json freezes native3 and processed2 hashes; every run records actual package/provenance/QA/native metadata/script/compiler/source/roadmap identity.
status_semantics: PASS is local shared-kernel and separately attached runtime-rate control evidence only; not generic chemistry executor, I23 lifetime, M3 qualification or measured plasma validation. FAIL is an evaluated numerical/control discrepancy; ERROR is build/runtime/parser/hash corruption; SKIPPED means required data/compiler/capability unavailable.
